name: Padharosa Art
description: At Padharosa.Art, it is our endeavor to showcase to the entire world, the astounding and amazing skills of artisans across the entire Indian landscape who can virtually create magic with their hands! In this exciting journey, we aim to bring the best of Indian handicrafts to the world and become the gold standard in Indian handicrafts. We intend to become a global market place for Indian handicrafts, where the best artisans can not only market their exceptional creations, but also get the best possible price without being slaves to ruthless merchants. In the process, we aim to enhance the living standards of these highly skilled individuals, most of who still live in abject poverty and do not get the due reward and recognition they deserve.

featured_reviews.name: Mustafa Dahodwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Century of Timeless Treasures
Stepping into this century-old antique shop is like stepping back in time. The creaking floorboards and dusty shelves are filled with a treasure trove of history. From vintage furniture to delicate porcelain, every item tells a story.
The shop's knowledgeable staff is always on hand to provide insights into the history and provenance of their pieces. Their passion for antiques is evident in their enthusiasm and expertise.
Whether you're a seasoned collector or simply looking for a unique piece to add to your home, this antique shop is a must-visit. It's a place where you can discover the beauty and charm of the past.
